style: Say curiously and warmly, like a friendly school librarian
lines: Forty-two thousand people saw this. Press Play, then tap each shot and label it.
Pick a size, angle, sound and job, then tap Check shot.
You checked all eight shots. Compare Nina’s notes, then trace the copies.
Five copies, five changes. Pick two cards and open Compare, Sound or Captions.
It can’t copy something posted after it.
Case closed on that one. Your clues prove it.
Not yet. Look closer at the clues.
Read Nina’s words first. Then decide what each repost owed her.
Tap a repost first. Then tap the earlier card it copied from.
Choose a question and a card. Tap Choose findings to attach two clues.
Tap Investigate. Pick two cards, then open two clue tools to save findings.
Tap two saved findings, then tap Back to claim.
Pick Fair, Not fair or It depends for each repost. Add a reason, then choose what a repost owes the maker.
Drag either film clock to compare the same moment. Then tap Back to board.
